columns.description: Stores kanban board columns (e.g., To Do, In Progress, Done)

schema.title: string - Name of the column
schema.order: integer - Position of the column on the board
schema.created_at: datetime - When the column was created

schema.title: string - Title of the note
schema.content: string - Body text of the note
schema.column_id: string - References the _id of the parent column
schema.order: integer - Position of the note within its column
schema.color: string - Background color of the note card
schema.created_at: datetime - When the note was created
schema.updated_at: datetime - When the note was last updated
